candidates.topic: Waning Crescent Moon in Cancer — Emotional Endings
candidates.teaser: The Moon is in Cancer right now — and it's doing something most people completely miss during this phase.
candidates.video_title: Waning Crescent in Cancer — What You're Supposed to Let Go
candidates.video_description: The Waning Crescent Moon in Cancer on September 7 signals a deep emotional release cycle. This is the chart's quiet instruction to stop holding on. Learn what astrology says this phase is really for.
candidates.script: The Moon is in Cancer right now — and it's almost gone. This Waning Crescent phase is the lunar cycle's final exhale, and in Cancer, astrologers say it hits the emotional body hardest. Cancer rules home, memory, and everything you secretly refuse to release. This isn't a time to start anything. Traditional lunar astrology reads this as a signal to grieve quietly, let old feelings dissolve, and clear space before the next New Moon arrives. What are you still holding that this cycle is asking you to finally put down?

candidates.topic: Mars in Cancer Conjunct the Moon — Emotional Flashpoint
candidates.teaser: Mars and the Moon are sitting in the exact same degree of Cancer right now — astrologers call this a collision.
candidates.video_title: Mars Meets Moon in Cancer — Emotional Flashpoint Today
candidates.video_description: On September 7, Mars sits at 17° Cancer while the Moon moves through 28° Cancer — both in the same emotionally charged sign. In astrology, Mars conjunct the Moon in Cancer can amplify reactive emotions and defensive instincts. Here's what that actually means for you.
candidates.script: Mars and the Moon are both in Cancer right now — and that combination is one astrology doesn't take lightly. Mars is the planet of drive, aggression, and reaction. The Moon rules your emotional core. When they share the same sign, traditional astrology says your feelings don't just surface — they ignite. Cancer is already the most protective sign in the zodiac. Put Mars there and that protection can tip into defensiveness fast. If something felt personal today, this placement might be exactly why. Which sign are you?

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — Conjunct Neptune Retrograde, Both at 13° and 3°
candidates.teaser: Saturn and Neptune are both retrograde in Aries right now — and they're closer together than most people realize.
candidates.video_title: Saturn & Neptune Retrograde in Aries — The Slow Collision
candidates.video_description: With Saturn at 13° Aries retrograde and Neptune at 3° Aries retrograde on September 7, these two slow-moving planets are sharing the same sign in reverse motion. Astrologers call this a rare and disorienting combination — structure dissolving from the inside out.
candidates.script: Saturn and Neptune are both retrograde in Aries right now — and in astrology, that pairing is genuinely unusual. Saturn is the planet of rules, limits, and hard reality. Neptune dissolves everything it touches. When they occupy the same sign in reverse motion, astrologers describe it as a period where the structures you built on shaky foundations start to feel it. Aries rules identity and initiative. So the question this transit keeps asking is: what are you pushing for — and is the foundation underneath it actually real?

candidates.topic: The Astrological 8th House — Transformation, Debt, and What You Can't Control
candidates.teaser: The 8th house is the part of your birth chart most people don't want to look at — but it explains a lot.
candidates.video_title: The 8th House — The Part of Your Chart Nobody Talks About
candidates.video_description: The 8th house in astrology governs transformation, shared resources, death and rebirth cycles, and everything outside your control. It's one of the most misunderstood placements in the chart — and one of the most revealing.
candidates.script: If there's one house in your birth chart that tells the truth about you — it's the 8th. In traditional astrology, the 8th house rules transformation, debt, inheritance, and the things in your life you simply cannot control. It's associated with Scorpio and Pluto — both known for going where most people refuse to. Astrologers say wherever Pluto sits in your chart, the 8th house theme follows. This is the house of endings that become beginnings. Most people skip it. The ones who don't tend to understand themselves on a completely different level.

candidates.topic: Venus in Libra — What Happens When a Planet Rules Its Own Sign
candidates.teaser: Venus is in Libra right now — and that specific placement changes how this planet behaves in a way most people never learn.
candidates.video_title: Venus in Libra — Why This Placement Hits Different
candidates.video_description: With Venus currently at 28° Libra, it's operating in its own sign — what astrologers call domicile. This is considered one of Venus's strongest and most natural expressions. Here's what that means for love, beauty, and relationships right now.
candidates.script: Venus is at 28° Libra right now — and that matters more than most people realize. In astrology, when a planet occupies the sign it rules, it's called domicile. Venus rules Libra. So right now, astrologers consider Venus to be operating at full strength — its values, its preferences, its way of connecting completely unfiltered. Libra is the sign of balance, beauty, and partnership. Traditional astrology says this placement makes charm effortless but also raises the stakes on fairness in relationships. What feels out of balance in yours right now?
